contract: §56m. The tag names a front matter's tags lists hold (front matter without its --- fences). The frontend's readers read this file (src/utils/__tests__/frontmatter-tag-readers.test.ts): the tag bar (parseFrontmatterTags), the journal search (extractFrontmatterFields) and the journal tag index (extractTagsFromContent, lowercased and sorted). The names are those the backend's front-matter tag reader (extract_frontmatter_tags) gives; the rows were measured against it (2026-10-24) and are meant to merge into the backend's fixture. Not here, on purpose: a comma inside a quoted inline item, which the frontend does not split and the backend does. Every character outside ASCII is written as a JSON unicode escape.
